title: Jobber vs Housecall Pro (2026): Pricing, Users & Features Compared
description: Jobber vs Housecall Pro side by side: published plan prices, included users, card fees, routing and QuickBooks sync, sourced from each vendor's pricing page.
h1: Jobber vs Housecall Pro: pricing and features, sourced
body:
Jobber and Housecall Pro are the two general-purpose field service platforms most small service businesses shortlist. Below we compare only what each vendor publishes on its own pricing page. Where a number isn't public, we mark it unknown rather than guess.

{{table:jobber,housecall-pro}}

Price: who is cheaper to start?

Jobber's entry Core plan lists $29/mo billed annually (with a promotional $21/mo for 12 months through Oct 30, 2026), or $49/mo with no commitment, for 1 user. Housecall Pro's Basic plan lists $59/mo billed annually for 1 user. Housecall Pro doesn't show Essentials or MAX prices on its public page, so we can't compare the higher tiers fairly.

Users and team size

Jobber charges $29/mo per extra user, and its Plus plan includes 5 users. Housecall Pro's Essentials includes 5 users and MAX includes 8, with $35/mo per additional user on MAX.

Payments

Jobber lists 2.9% + 30¢ for online card payments, 2.7% + 30¢ for Tap to Pay and 1% for ACH. Housecall Pro lists card processing "as low as 2.59%" and a 1% fee on bank payments.

Routing

Housecall Pro puts basic routes on Essentials and one-click route optimization on MAX. Jobber lists routing in its feature table; check the vendor's table for which plan includes it.

Trials and contracts

Both offer a 14-day free trial with no credit card (Jobber on Grow, Housecall Pro on MAX). Jobber offers monthly no-commitment, 1-year monthly, and annual prepaid billing; annual prepaid is non-refundable. Housecall Pro says it doesn't require long-term contracts.

Which should you pick?

  • Solo operator on a tight budget: Jobber Core has the lowest published entry price.
  • Small crew that wants several users included: Housecall Pro Essentials includes 5 users. Get a quote, since the price isn't public.
  • Pool or pest route business: also look at trade-specific tools like Skimmer and GorillaDesk.

Try both: {{aff:jobber|Start a Jobber trial}} · {{aff:housecallpro|Start a Housecall Pro trial}}
faq: Is Jobber cheaper than Housecall Pro?
At entry level, yes, based on published prices: Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually vs Housecall Pro Basic at $59/mo billed annually (both checked 2026-10-21).
Do Jobber and Housecall Pro have free trials?
Yes. Both list a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
